scope: Read-only literal media coverage; no permission, content or release approval

platform_exemptions.scope: platform-shell asset; not application content permission evidence

limitations: Static HTML media attributes, CSS url() and literal JS/JSON media properties only.
Computed/escaped URLs, dynamic templates, imported shared scripts, JS string markup and runtime network/media behavior are not certified.
Permission labels require recorded evidence but are not independently adjudicated; attribution is not permission.
